head: iPhone Duo computer mode: DuoMiniMac adds a desktop and trackpad
dek: DuoMiniMac is a new $4.99 app that turns the unfolded iPhone Duo into a small laptop-style desktop, with windows, a menu bar and a Dock on the top half and a keyboard and trackpad on the bottom half. It was #97 in paid Utilities apps on the US App Store on 15 November.
details: Inside it you can open files you pick from the Files app, write in a text editor, browse the web and play your own videos in a window. Your music plays on a pretend turntable, CD player or cassette player, which shows on the outer screen when the phone is folded. The latest update adds an offline English-Chinese dictionary, a Snake game and pixel pets for its clock. The listing says it imitates a desktop and runs as a normal iPhone app; the maker is listed as 君 盛.
means: If you want your iPhone Duo to feel more like a tiny laptop, this gives you a desktop look, but it's an app on iOS, not a real Mac.
todo: Read the listing before buying: it plays only videos and music already on your phone.
thumb_words: IPHONE DUO GETS A MINI DESKTOP
